title: Worked fine until it completely stopped working.
text: Worked fine until it completely stopped working.. Worked decent until it stopped working all together.  I bought this in May 2019.  I used it a lot.  I don't own an oven.  I used this hot plate and a toaster oven for cooking.  It started acting up a month ago and now it just stopped working and will no longer heat up.  The price is great but if you want a hot plate to last more than a few years, I would steer clear of this one.
